Which one should you buy?

For most households: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 — a strong balance of battery capacity and output.

For a budget under $750: BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 — the most affordable of these higher-capacity bundles.

For longer outages or RV trips: BLUETTI Elite 300 — the largest battery in this shortlist.

For shopping at Costco: Jackery Explorer 1500 v2 bundle.

One important distinction: battery capacity determines how long your devices can run, while panel wattage influences how quickly the battery can recharge in sunlight. Actual solar charging depends on weather, shade, panel orientation, and system losses.

My recommendation: Start with the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 bundle at $1,399. If you tell me your budget and whether this is primarily for home power outages or camping, I can narrow the choice to the best fit.
